open_issues: Slot 23 (UTA native) and slot 27 (LAC native, held by NYK) were exchanged UTA<->NYK on draft day (2020-11-18); recorded pre-draft holders UTA (23) and NYK (27). CBS_order20 shows the post-swap labels; WIKI_2020 classifies it as a draft-day trade.

Slot 16 (POR) went to DET via HOU and slot 24 (IND->MIL) went via NOP to DEN in trades completed after the draft (2020-11-22 and later); pre-draft holders POR and MIL recorded. Other draft-night moves (17 MIN->OKC, 19 BKN->DET, 21/25/28/30) likewise ignored.
DEN->OKC: HR_jun20 labels the pick 'unprotected' (protection was moot by then); earlier sources give top-10 protection, which is what is recorded.
Realized-holder check: applying every native's rule to its realized slot reproduces the pre-draft holder for all 30 picks (no mismatches).
